actual_boundary_analysis.geometric_distance: when projected hidden rows and public E are available, use normal E[w]-E[c], signed distance z·normal/||normal|| and its signed displacement; verify score_margin = logit_scale * distance * ||normal|| within tolerance
actual_boundary_analysis.runner_up_rule: mask the full-vocabulary winner then torch.argmax; this is the minimum score margin competitor, not a Euclidean nearest hyperplane
actual_boundary_analysis.signed_score_margin: m_before = b[w]-b[c]; m_after = u[w]-u[c]; signed_displacement = m_after-m_before; negative points toward c
actual_boundary_analysis.strict_crossing: baseline argmax != updated argmax AND m_before >= 0 AND m_after < 0
actual_boundary_analysis.tie_transition: baseline argmax != updated argmax AND m_after == 0; report separately from strict crossing
actual_boundary_analysis.transition_competitor: updated full-vocabulary winner when its ID differs from baseline, otherwise baseline full-vocabulary runner-up
actual_boundary_analysis.unsigned_movement: report only as diagnostic; never label it a crossing or causal failure
actual_boundary_analysis.winner_rule: torch.argmax over all 128256 vocabulary scores, exact package tie rule

claim_scope: One declared trajectory and its paired reconstruction panel only. This auxiliary result cannot complete or replace the canonical dual-benchmark matrix and must not be generalized to all fine-tuning.

early_direction_predictor.freeze_rule: materialize predictor outputs for all registered rows before any evaluation truth is opened; later stage scores are used only for post-freeze forecast evaluation
early_direction_predictor.heldout_check: report all rows and a predeclared disjoint source-order half; no source/stage selection from later truth
early_direction_predictor.interpretation: prospective risk association only; it does not establish that a later failure crossed an actual decoder boundary
early_direction_predictor.margin: for each forecast t, score of the stage-0 winner w0 minus the maximum estimated score over every v != w0
early_direction_predictor.predicted_tie: risk == 0; retain torch.argmax forecast ID separately for tie handling
early_direction_predictor.target_label_after_freeze: baseline-correct and later-stage-wrong token (broken token); report baseline errors and improved tokens separately

implementation_tests: CPU synthetic full-vocabulary crossing with changed argmax
CPU synthetic away-update with large unsigned movement and no crossing
CPU synthetic tie transition under torch.argmax
CPU synthetic extrapolation using stages 0/64 only
CPU source-paired broken/improved/exact-clip counts and deterministic intervals
frozen-package B1 one-record geometry smoke; no output artifact
limitations: one trajectory is not a universal fine-tuning robustness claim
actual crossing analysis is retrospective explanatory evidence after score generation
forecast validation is predictive association, not causal proof
optional A1+A2 is limited and cannot complete the canonical matrix

paired_scoring.domains: each declared domain separately; do not pool domains or stages

optional_comparator.rows: first 32 in the already frozen source order

paired_scoring.truth_boundary: all B1 predictions, compact boundary rows, predictor outputs, stage IDs, source-order bindings, and timing artifacts freeze before truth; truth is scorer input only after freeze

uncertainty.rate_ci: validated bootstrap_ratio over source records; UNKNOWN on nonpositive denominator

question: Does the frozen expanded B1 decoder retain reconstruction quality along one compatible public target-training trajectory, and do early score-direction forecasts identify later correctness failures?

resource_preflight.compact_artifact: retain full-vocabulary winner/runner-up IDs, cross-winner scores, margins, and optional geometric rows; raw logits are ephemeral
resource_preflight.execution: stream one record or a bounded small chunk; never materialize full-panel [records,127,128256] logits in RAM
resource_preflight.release_gate: CPU one-record adapter smoke and geometry checks pass before any GPU or target-trajectory release

trajectory.stage_pairing: same target checkpoint lineage, same public source panel, same cut/rendering/mask/position/numerical path
